blockers.cause: Runner main has no exception boundary; an expected absent-gate RuntimeError reaches sys.excepthook/apport.
blockers.evidence: Gate denial occurred before transport/output, but RuntimeError propagated and the operational invocation attempted /var/crash.
blockers.minimal_fix: Catch expected CLI errors, emit one sanitized technical diagnostic, and return nonzero without traceback.

blockers.cause: CLI exposes only --verify-freeze and --controls while the external gate requires a recent endpoint/context-bound preflight artifact.
blockers.minimal_fix: Add a frozen no-clobber --preflight action behind a distinct preliminary gate.

blockers.cause: Pre-gold validation neither closes result keys nor validates the expanded full-frame contract.
blockers.evidence: A complete fake batch mutated to expanded_frame={} opened source_controls34 before rejection.
blockers.minimal_fix: Close result shapes per status and run a pinned full-frame validator before every gold identity.

blockers.cause: Default urlopen honors proxy environment and follows redirects; counters are initialized to one rather than counting actual opens.
blockers.evidence: An in-memory 302 caused two handler opens including non-loopback while status PASS and socket_attempts=1; an in-memory proxy probe changed the actual host to proxy.invalid.
blockers.minimal_fix: Use a frozen opener with ProxyHandler({}) and redirect denial, restrict endpoints to literal loopback IPs, and count every real open.

blockers.cause: The runner output writer re-resolves the parent by pathname after inference instead of retaining a no-follow directory fd.
blockers.evidence: Exclusive hard-link/fsync is present, but no openat no-follow parent chain exists in the runner writer; the evaluator writer has one.
blockers.minimal_fix: Use the evaluator's anchored dirfd/no-follow exclusive atomic writer pattern.

passed_properties: Freeze/hash chain and direct dependency trees match current bytes.
External gate absence fails closed before transport and output.
The direct non-redirecting fake path performs one GET plus 34 POSTs with zero retries.
Runner runtime access stays query-only and does not open fixture, oracle or evaluator artifacts.
Generated runner batches are query-free and diagnostic text-free.
Unexpected local case exceptions preserve completed records.
Offline evaluation binds the exact input batch SHA and writes a separate artifact only after evaluation.
Bounded no-follow readers reject size, symlink and descriptor-identity mutations.
The current compact schema and adapter bound a complete serialized batch well below 32 MiB.
next_step: Create and independently review a successor that fixes all blocker causes. Do not create or open an external live gate for V26.5.6.
